facts.claim: GHSA-r5pp-p5r8-466r / CVE-2026-72718: goose review runs git without stripping attacker .git/config; <1.44.0; published 2026-07-24

D04.rationale: No trust prompt; .goosehints/AGENTS.md read from cwd and parents; goose review executed repo git config (core.fsmonitor) before any model call (CVE-2026-72718).

D05.rationale: Extension install allowlist via GOOSE_ALLOWLIST URL plus OSV malware (MAL-*) check before launching stdio extensions; no project-level MCP file; no tool-description pinning.

facts.claim: Keyring recommended; secrets.yaml plaintext when keyring unavailable or GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING set

D07.rationale: System keyring by default, plaintext secrets.yaml fallback (headless/CI); API keys in config.yaml ignored.

D08.rationale: `goose run` headless inherits GOOSE_MODE (default auto); --max-turns default 1000; optional prompt-injection detector off by default.
